data.title: Agent Loop
data.tagline: A runtime mechanism that repeatedly calls AI and tools, then uses check results to continue, pause, or stop
data.learningOutcome: You can name the conditions an agent loop controls and distinguish it from ReAct.
data.description: While fixing horizontal overflow in mobile navigation, the first failed check can start another round. A second identical failure or a change to shared styles pauses for confirmation. The task ends only after the build and 390px page check both pass.

learning.assumes: You have seen an AI assistant read, edit, and check work in steps.
learning.outcome: You can name the conditions an agent loop controls and distinguish it from ReAct.

explanation.title: Continue after an initial failure
explanation.text: If the failure is new and attempts remain, the application passes the check result into another round.

explanation.title: Pause at a limit or approval boundary
explanation.text: Two identical failures or a proposed shared-style change pauses the loop with its evidence.

explanation.title: Stop after real checks pass
explanation.text: The task ends only when the build passes and the 390px page no longer overflows.

data.boundary: ReAct explains how new evidence changes the next action. An agent loop controls whether the application runs another round, including attempt, permission, pause, and stop conditions.

lessonPractice.title: An agent tries to fix mobile navigation, but the same horizontal-overflow check fails twice. The rule allows two attempts for the same failure. What should happen next?

options.label: Pause, preserve both check results, and ask before expanding the change scope
options.feedback: The repeated failure has reached its limit, so the loop should pause and present evidence instead of expanding changes.

options.label: Mark the task complete because the agent already tried twice
options.feedback: Attempt count is not proof; the build and mobile-page check have not passed.

options.label: Keep editing automatically until the check passes, with no further limit
options.feedback: This bypasses the stated limit and can let the change scope keep growing.

data.agentPrompt: Fix the mobile navigation overflow. After each change, run the build and inspect the page at 390px. Allow at most two attempts for the same failure and pause before changing shared navigation styles. Finish only when both checks pass, and report why each round continued, paused, or completed.
